scope: Static contract validation of the property registration UI integration.

checks.check: index contains property registration route controls
site.js contains all six registration route handlers
each route maps to a distinct registration engine
UI does not assert property-specific ownership without retrieval
current and historical routes remain distinct
official route language does not guarantee outcome
conflict/evidence limitations are visible in route logic
verification date is current for the integrated property route
source content and website contract references exist

warnings: Static validation does not prove browser rendering.
Static validation does not prove GitHub Pages deployment.
Static validation does not retrieve a real property record.
Substantive legal verification remains governed by the underlying verified content and source audits.
